lines.beaver: 이제 골짜기 입구예요. 길이 꽤 험하네요.
lines.beaver_en: We're at the valley entrance now. The path is quite rough.
lines.beaver_roman: ije goljjagi ipguyeyo. giri kkwae heomhaneyo.
lines.en: Yes, there's a lot of gravel, so we should watch our step.

lines.beaver: 저 너머는 뭐예요? 산이 끝없이 이어지네요.
lines.beaver_en: What's beyond there? The mountains go on forever.
lines.beaver_roman: jeo neomeoneun mwoyeyo? sani kkeudeopsi ieojineyo.
lines.learner: 큰 산맥이에요. 이 일대는 전부 산간 지역이에요.
lines.en: It's a big mountain range. This whole area is mountainous.
lines.roman: keun sanmaegieyo. i ildaeneun jeonbu sangan jiyeogieyo.

lines.beaver_en: The forest is really dense. It's like a jungle.
lines.en: Right. The trees have grown really densely.

lines.beaver: 앞에 하천이 있어요. 하천을 건너야 해요.
lines.beaver_en: There's a river ahead. We have to cross it.
lines.beaver_roman: ape hacheoni isseoyo. hacheoneul geonneoya haeyo.
lines.learner: 물살이 세 보여요. 유비무환이니 밧줄을 묶을게요.
lines.en: The current looks strong. Better safe than sorry, I'll tie a rope.
lines.roman: mulsari se boyeoyo. yubimuhwanini batjureul mukkeulgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Where does this river flow to?
lines.en: It flows across the plain to the sea.

lines.beaver_en: If we go to the sea, we'll see the horizon too.
lines.learner: 네, 하구에 가면 수평선이 탁 트여 보여요.
lines.en: Yes, at the river mouth the horizon opens up wide.
lines.roman: ne, hague gamyeon supyeongseoni tak teuyeo boyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The water is so clear we can see underwater life.
lines.en: Fish are hiding between the rocks in the water.

lines.beaver: 이 주변 지형에 대해 좀 더 알려 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Tell me a bit more about the terrain around here.
lines.beaver_roman: i jubyeon jihyeonge daehae jom deo allyeo juseyo.
lines.en: The slope over there is gentle, and the valley is wide.

lines.beaver_en: Shall we head back to camp before it gets dark?
lines.learner: 네, 해가 지기 전에 골짜기를 빠져나가요.
lines.en: Yes, let's get out of the valley before sunset.
lines.roman: ne, haega jigi jeone goljjagireul ppajyeonagayo.

lines.beaver: 오늘 수고 많았어요. 내일은 산맥 쪽으로 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Great work today. Tomorrow we'll head toward the mountain range.
lines.beaver_roman: oneul sugo manasseoyo. naeireun sanmaek jjogeuro gayo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 내일도 자갈길이 많을 테니 단단히 준비해요.
lines.en: Sounds good. There'll be gravel paths again, so let's prepare well.
lines.roman: joayo. naeildo jagalgiri maneul teni dandanhi junbihaeyo.
